The 17 October 2026 run used Rust/Cargo 1.99.0, SPIN 6.5.2 and GCC 13.3.0. Each model command had a 30-second, 512-MiB limit and depth 100,000. Successful verification searches exhaustively explored the specified finite abstractions. Defect counterexamples demonstrate detection of the introduced faults.
